messages:
elaine: Dropping notes from the quick design pass — sketched a compact min/max row with hover preview for burst cost + a tiny haptic affordance for mobile. Prototype: https://figma.redwood/compact-minmax-haptics

diego: Nice. Couple quick things: hover previews are great on desktop but need a11y fallback for keyboard and mobile.

sam: Agreed. For keyboard, show the same preview as a focus tooltip. Use `aria-describedby` on the min/max control that points to the preview content (kept in DOM but visually hidden until focus).

kevin: Accessibility + motion: the mobile haptic should be optional in OS settings. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` by disabling subtle scale animations. Also make touch targets 44px min in compact mode.

aria-bot: a11y note: hover-only triggers fail SR users. Provide `role=tooltip` with `aria-hidden=false/true` toggles and ensure the preview content has an `aria-live=polite` summary when values change: "Min now 2 GPUs, estimated +0.8% cost".

diego: Copy: preview header read "Temporary capacity preview" and inside show: duration, GPUs added, est. cost delta, and link "View billing assumptions". Short action: "Apply burst" becomes "Enable temporary capacity".

elaine: On mobile I proposed a short haptic pulse when the user taps the burst pill 94 but we should not rely on it for confirmation. Add an explicit success toast and SR announce.

sam: For keyboard reorder in compact rows, recommend a dedicated reorder mode (activate via keyboard shortcut) that switches items to `aria-grabbed` state. That avoids accidental drags.

kevin: Visual: hover preview should not overlap important controls. If it would overlap, place it inline below the row. Also ensure contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for text in the preview.

aria-bot: Provide example SR strings for figma notes: 1) On preview show: `aria-live=polite` "Preview: +2 GPUs for 15m, est +0.9% cost". 2) On enable: `aria-live=assertive` "Temporary capacity enabled on Pool-X". 3) On failure: `aria-live=assertive` "Could not enable temporary capacity. Try again".

diego: UX question: compact rows hide long pool descriptions. Make sure essential meta (SLO, region, cost tier) stays visible. Use `sr-only` for any hidden meta but keep it available in DOM.

elaine: Plan: 1) wire keyboard tooltip via `aria-describedby`, 2) add SR strings and toast copy, 3) add setting to toggle haptics, 4) ensure 44px targets and reduced motion. I'll push updated figma with annotations by EOD.

sam: I'll review the keyboard reorder spec. @kevin can you sanity-check motion/haptics constraints?

kevin: on it. Will also validate preview placement on narrow widths.

aria-bot: Reminder: include the accessibility checklist in figma notes: focus order, tooltip semantics, live regions, reduced motion, 44px targets, keyboard reorder mode.

elaine: Thanks everyone 94 looping back after updates. :sparkles:
